question: The Indian Olympic Association was formed in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1927**__.

**__Key Points__**
__

• The **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)** was established in the year **1927**. It is the apex body responsible for the **Olympic Movement** and the **Commonwealth Games** in **India**.

• The organization was founded by **Sir Dorabji Tata** and **Dr. A.G. Noehren**. **Sir Dorabji Tata** served as the **first President**, while **Dr. A.G. Noehren** was the **first Secretary General**.

• In **1927**, the **International Olympic Committee (IOC)** officially recognized the **Indian Olympic Association** as the **National Olympic Committee** for **India**.

• The formation of the **IOA** was a pivotal moment in formalizing **India's** participation in international multi-sport events, ensuring a structured approach to athlete selection and training.

• Regarding the other options: **1920** is the year **India** sent its first organized team to the **Antwerp Olympics**, but the **IOA** was not yet formed. **1930** marks the year of the first **British Empire Games** (now **Commonwealth Games**). **1947** is the year of **Indian Independence**.

**Additional Information__**
__

• **First Participation:** **India** first participated in the **Olympic Games** in **1900** at the **Paris Olympics**. The country was represented by a lone athlete, **Norman Pritchard**, who won **two silver medals** in athletics (**200m** and **200m hurdles**).

• **Headquarters:** The headquarters of the **Indian Olympic Association** is located in **New Delhi**. It operates as a **Non-Profit Organization** registered under the **Societies Registration Act of 1860**.

• **Leadership:** In **December 2022**, the legendary sprinter **P.T. Usha** was elected as the **first woman President** of the **Indian Olympic Association**. She is also the first Olympian to lead the body.

• **Functions:** The **IOA** is responsible for managing the **Indian** contingents for the **Summer Olympics**, **Winter Olympics**, **Asian Games**, and **Commonwealth Games**. It also coordinates with various **National Sports Federations (NSFs)**.

• **Affiliations:** The **IOA** is a member of the **International Olympic Committee (IOC)**, the **Olympic Council of Asia (OCA)**, and the **Commonwealth Games Federation (CGF)**.

**Important Points__**

• **Early Efforts:** Before the formal establishment in **1927**, **Sir Dorabji Tata** personally financed the **Indian** team for the **1920 Antwerp Olympics**. A provisional **All-India Olympic Committee** was set up in **1923** to handle the **1924 Paris Olympics**.

• **Legal Status:** The **IOA** is governed by the **Olympic Charter** and its own constitution. It works closely with the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, **Government of India**, although it maintains its autonomy as a **National Olympic Committee**.

• **Role in Sports Development:** Beyond event management, the **IOA** plays a crucial role in promoting the **Olympic values** of **friendship**, **solidarity**, and **fair play** across the **country**.
